title: Choose the visual world for ICS
question: One direction is assigned for the ICS website. Keep it, take my pick or the standard, or re-roll. The logo and name stay exactly as on the letterhead in every option.

options.label: The Stamp Desk
options.lineage: Delhi office files, rubber stamps and date seals
options.thesis: Every job ICS takes moves like an office file: Received, Entered, Checked, Delivered — stamped in ICS red.
options.viewport: The whole viewport is one manila file cover: ICS printed as the issuing office, the subject line is the headline, and a pinned routing slip is a working enquiry form that opens WhatsApp to Kunal while stamps press down in sequence.
options.risk: If the stamps get cute it reads as a gimmick; it must stay as ordered as a real registry.

raised.raise: Six services, six stamps, each owning one job in a fixed ranked grid; reading it is the cross-check.
State lives in impression form (outlined pending, solid inked done), never in extra colours; two inks only.
One file, never a pile of cards: the process is numbered 01–04 in a strict margin column down the page.
Crimson is reserved for the action and the stamp of approval; nothing decorative wears it.

options.label: The Bahi-Khata Ledger
options.thesis: The site is the red ledger every Indian business keeps: services as ruled entries, contact as the closing total.
options.viewport: A red cloth cover with the ICS logo blocked in, opening to a ruled spread where services are line items and the call button is the total.
options.risk: Familiar: where most accounting sites land, and ledger paper drifts to cream-and-serif default.

options.label: Photocopy Paste-up
options.thesis: Services as a photocopied flyer slapped down warm from the copier.
options.viewport: A crooked flyer with ransom headline and biro contact details.
options.case: Delhi knows the xerox shop, but crooked grit contradicts the accuracy ICS sells.
options.kept: One ink reserved for the action.
options.risk: Reads careless, the opposite of an accuracy promise.

options.label: Night Instrument Panel
options.thesis: Six services as six calm gauges.
options.viewport: Two rows of three dials on black.
options.case: Business owners do not see themselves in a cockpit; services become metaphors.
options.kept: Each element owns exactly one truth in a fixed, ranked grid.

options.label: Emission-Line Rail
options.thesis: Everything hangs off one calibrated rail.
options.viewport: A dark plate with thin coloured lines.
options.case: Too abstract for an owner choosing a vendor on a phone.
options.kept: State carried in line form, not colour.
options.risk: Cold and illegible to this audience.

options.label: Folded Crane Sequence
options.thesis: One sheet transformed through numbered folds.
options.viewport: A red square folding into a crane.
options.case: Beautiful, but foreign to a Delhi back-office buyer.
options.kept: One continuous sheet with strictly numbered steps.

options.label: Street-Magazine Density
options.viewport: A packed spread of cut-outs and tags.
options.case: Wrong energy and audience for accounting work.
options.kept: Every item labelled precisely with what it includes.
options.risk: Noise where calm is the promise.

options.label: Gravity-Rain Garden
options.thesis: Rain falling by its own laws.
options.viewport: A dusk garden with coloured rain.
options.case: No link to the product or its buyers.
options.kept: One consistent physical law for all motion.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean corporate services site in ICS red and charcoal, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Logo and nav, headline with call button beside a photo, a services grid below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other BPO site by design.
